fixes.name: Geo-11
fixes.pros: Excellent depth, works on modern hardware. Actively maintained.
fixes.cons: Cutscenes may render incorrectly. HairWorks can have depth issues.
issues: Disable HairWorks or set to Geralt-only for best results
Some particle effects may clip at high separation values
fixes.notes: One of the best Geo-11 fixes available. The Next Gen update (4.0+) is supported. Switch to DX11 in the launcher — Geo-11 does not support DX12.

fixes.name: TriDef 3D
fixes.pros: Worked well at release with minimal setup.
fixes.cons: TriDef is discontinued. License servers offline. No modern OS support.
issues: TriDef software is no longer available or activatable
Does not support the Next Gen (4.0) update
fixes.notes: Documented for historical reference only. Use the Geo-11 fix instead.

fixes.name: VorpX (VR)
fixes.rendering_method_note: Geometry 3D mode. VorpX's Z-Normal mode uses Single-View Depth Reprojection.
fixes.pros: Full VR headset support with headtracking. SBS output available for flat 3D displays.
fixes.cons: Paid software. Not true VR rendering — geometry injection has limits. Motion sickness possible.
issues: FOV and scale require manual tuning per headset
Next Gen update (4.0) compatibility varies — check VorpX profile list
fixes.notes: VorpX is a commercial VR injector. The Witcher 3 has a curated Geometry 3D profile. For flat 3D displays, Geo-11 is the superior choice — VorpX's SBS output is mainly useful as a side-effect of its VR mode.
